title: Land Cover Rewind 1985–2025: built-up land and land cover from the Landsat archive for any area
description:
Land Cover Rewind reconstructs built-up land and four-class land cover (built-up, trees and forest, water, other) for the epochs 1985–2025 at 30 m for any area covered by the Landsat archive. A Random Forest classifier trained on a present-day 10 m land cover map labels Landsat Collection 2 Level 2 composites of earlier years; an extent mask (Impact Observatory/Esri LULC 2017 and 2023) and monotonic accumulation turn per-epoch probabilities into a consistent series. The package reports landscape metrics and growth forms for every period and computes SDG indicator 11.3.1 (ratio of land consumption rate to population growth rate) from the series and a population grid of two dates. All data are read anonymously from the Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC catalogue; no account is required.

Contents: Python package landcoverrewind, bilingual (Polish and English) Streamlit browser app, command-line interface, pretrained models for Toruń and Bydgoszcz (Poland) with model cards and training points, evaluation files, unit tests on synthetic data, example area, user guide. Version 1.3.0 added the SDG 11.3.1 module (app panel, command line, API). Version 1.3.1 selects IO LULC maps by year (the last map in the catalogue is 2023; results unchanged), validates user CRS, geometry and inputs, marks no-data pixels, records library versions and map identifiers in metadata.json and ships a full environment file; the series computation is unchanged. The folder analysis contains the scripts and result files of the evaluation described in the accompanying manuscript. Code: MIT; models and results: CC BY 4.0.
